method: Conservative observed SDK wall time from the initial freeze probe, including model loading. Peak is scheduler-accounted process GB sampled every five seconds during the real-app freeze run. Time and peak come from separate runs. The shared queue can add arbitrary waiting time.
limitations: Sparse samples can miss short memory peaks. These measurements do not prove a discrete GPU fit or benchmark other hardware tiers. Only freeze has completed the real-app final and export check so far.
